//: Per-model reasoning/thinking adapter. Maps a model to the request-body fields
//1: that enable its deep-thinking mode on its host. Resolution order at call time:
//2: exact 'provider/model' -> logical name -> model family -> '*' default.
//3: 'body' is shallow-merged into the chat-completions request when reasoning is on.
//4: Every host exposes thinking differently, so these are filled in per model as we
//5: confirm the exact param from each provider's docs (editable, zero code changes).
//6: Leave 'body' empty {} to rely on big token budget + the model's default behaviour.
//7: IMPORTANT: the SAME logical model uses DIFFERENT param shapes per host - NVIDIA
//8: NIM uses chat_template_kwargs, OpenRouter uses top-level reasoning:{enabled}. So
//9: multi-host models are keyed by exact 'provider/model' to avoid leaking the wrong
//10: shape to a host that would reject it; single-host models keep the logical key.

*.note: default: no special param; rely on token budget + native behaviour

glm-5.1.note: NVIDIA NIM only; confirmed thinking mode

deepseek-v4-pro.note: NVIDIA NIM only; thinking + reasoning_effort max|high|none (confirmed)

nvidia/moonshotai/kimi-k2.6.note: NVIDIA NIM Kimi thinking (confirmed; top-level param, merged into body)

kimi-k2.6.note: fallback (e.g. cloudflare host): no thinking param

nvidia/nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b.note: NVIDIA NIM Nemotron-3 Ultra thinking + reasoning_budget (confirmed)
